title: A Unified Representation Underlying the Judgment of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Applying causal interventions (representational steering) along the model's internal Valence-Assent Axis (VAA) and measuring systematic shifts in the model's evaluative judgments across value judgments, sentiment analysis, and factual verification tasks.

bias_targets.target: Cognitive bias (Motivated reasoning and Confirmation bias)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's step-by-step reasoning (chain-of-thought) under VAA intervention to determine if it selectively retrieves evidence and constructs flawed but logically coherent justifications ('coherent hallucinations') to support an externally induced stance.
